description: This file defines data models and a fetcher class for Deribit Futures Info, including query parameters, data representation, and data fetching logic.

classes.name: DeribitFuturesInfoQueryParams
classes.description: Defines query parameters for Deribit futures instruments, including symbol validation.

classes.name: DeribitFuturesInfoData
classes.description: Represents the data structure for Deribit futures info, including price and volume details.

classes.name: DeribitFuturesInfoFetcher
classes.description: Handles fetching and transforming Deribit futures info data asynchronously.

methods.name: transform_query
methods.description: Converts a dictionary of parameters into a DeribitFuturesInfoQueryParams instance.
